result_semantic_payload.summary: The seized device belongs to wangfang. Activity attributable to the device user consists of three chat messages in /chat/wangfang.log dated 2024-04-10 between 21:02 and 21:31: expressing financial tightness and considering selling a car; mentioning that Lao Zhang plans a month-end meal; and stating arrival home. A third-party log, /chat/zhangming.log, is present on the same storage volume but is explicitly not an account on this device. Its messages from 2024-04-10 between 21:29 and 21:47 concern receiving three deposits totaling 88,000 USDT, platform backend showing five new registrations, and plans to maintain a group. While the logs exhibit temporal proximity, the README.txt explicitly states that timeline proximity alone must not be treated as interaction or causation, and zhangming is not an account on the device. No evidence supports direct interaction, causation, or shared intent between the device user and the third-party log.
